name: natala-backend
description: Natala API, realtime gateway and workers

scripts.db:seed: for f in db/seeds/*.sql; do echo "seeding $f"; docker compose exec -T postgres psql -q -U natala -d natala -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:test: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U natala -d natala -f - < db/smoke_test.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U natala -d natala
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:setup
